name: Crimson Cape
note: Imported by tools/import_cape_green.py from a sheet whose person was painted flat #00FF00. The cape is everything that is neither the magenta backdrop nor the green person, so no colour heuristic can eat a cape pixel. Registered by fitting the GREEN silhouette against the real stand-<dir> body, feet-anchored (the one landmark a cape never covers), scoring inside-minus-spill so a cape that hides most of the body still fits at its true scale rather than at zero.
